ezekiel.18.p1.b1.text: The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the teeth of the children are set on edge

ezekiel.18.p1.b2.text: Behold, every soul belongs to Me … The soul who sins is the one who will die.

ezekiel.18.p1.b3.text: gives his bread to the hungry and covers the naked with clothing. … That man is righteous; surely he will live

ezekiel.18.p1.b4.text: Will this son live? He will not!

ezekiel.18.p1.b5.text: Such a man will not die for his father’s iniquity. He will surely live.

ezekiel.18.p2.b1.text: The way of the Lord is not just.

ezekiel.18.p2.b2.text: Hear now, O house of Israel: Is it My way that is unjust? Is it not your ways that are unjust?

ezekiel.18.p2.b3.text: But if the wicked man turns from all the sins he has committed … he will surely live; he will not die.

ezekiel.18.p2.b4.text: Cast away from yourselves all the transgressions you have committed, and fashion for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit. Why should you die, O house of Israel?

ezekiel.18.p2.b5.text: For I take no pleasure in anyone’s death … So repent and live!
